<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/exceptions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists cases, newest opened first, one page at a time (`limit`,
`cursor`; keyset on opened-at then case id). An empty result is `200`
with `{"items": []}`, never a 404. `status`, `queue`, `site` and
`sourceType` narrow the list and are repeated on every page request;
`sourceType` is the full CloudEvents type of the source fact. Without
a `status` filter the list returns every open AND resolved case
matching the other filters (resolve activity is part of the record).
